llm.infoDescription: Configure the LLM API to enable position matching, smart recommendations and other features. API Keys are stored encrypted; the frontend only shows a masked value.
llm.chatSubtitle: Used for JD parsing and recommendation rationale generation
llm.embeddingSubtitle: Used for semantic search and similar-talent recommendations
llm.apiFormatTooltip: openai: OpenAI-compatible format; minimax: MiniMax-specific format
llm.embeddingApiFormatTooltip: API format of the embedding model; leave empty to reuse the chat model's API format
llm.embeddingApiFormatPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the chat model's format
llm.dimensionTooltip: Vector dimension output by the embedding model. Common values: OpenAI 1536, Qwen/BGE 1024. Note: changing the dimension clears existing vector data in the academic and open-source talent pools.

proxy.infoDescription: Configure an HTTP proxy to reach external APIs (OpenAlex, LLM, etc.). Intended for corporate intranet environments. The password is stored encrypted.
proxy.noProxyTooltip: Intranet service addresses, separated by commas. Requests matching these addresses connect directly without going through the proxy.
proxy.sslVerifyTooltip: Disable verification when the corporate proxy uses a self-signed certificate. Disabling it exposes you to man-in-the-middle attacks — use with caution.

github.infoDescription: Configure a GitHub Personal Access Token for open-source talent collection. Multiple tokens are rotated (comma-separated); each token is rate-limited to 5000 req/hour.
github.tokenTooltip: Multiple tokens supported, separated by commas. Each token requires the repo and read:user scopes.
github.tokenPlaceholder: Enter a GitHub Personal Access Token
github.baseUrlRequired: Please enter the API base URL
github.rateLimitTooltip: Used for monitoring alerts; a warning is raised at 80% utilization

apiKeys.revokeConfirmDescription: Revocation takes effect immediately; all calls using this key will return 401
apiKeys.title: API Key Management
apiKeys.intro: For external tools / Skills calling the open API (/api/v1/open-api/*). The plaintext key is shown only once at creation; permissions are granted at domain × read/write granularity.
apiKeys.rateLimitLabel: Rate limit (requests/minute, leave empty for the global default)
apiKeys.createdWarning: The plaintext key is shown only this once and cannot be viewed again after closing

industryImport.heading: Industry Talent Import
industryImport.description: Upload candidate JSONL produced by the smart-talent-sourcing skill (schema v1.0). The import is incremental: empty fields never overwrite existing data, and existing recruiting states (contact/status/notes) are preserved.
industryImport.uploadHint: Only a single .jsonl file is supported (skill output format, ≤ 20MB)
industryImport.noPositionSelected: Please select a target position first
industryImport.importDone: Import finished: {{inserted}} talents inserted / {{updated}} updated, {{linksInserted}} links inserted / {{linksUpdated}} updated, {{skipped}} lines skipped

agentChannel.movedTitle: API Keys have moved to "API Key Management"
agentChannel.movedDescriptionBefore: Import channel authentication is now part of the open API key system (scope:
agentChannel.movedDescriptionAfter: ). Creation, revocation and rate limiting are all handled on the "API Key Management" page; only the invocation guide remains here.

report.title: Import Report
report.missingOrgDescription: Records without a current company have weaker dedup discrimination (degraded dedup_hash); manual review is recommended.
report.abortedDescription: No valid records found in the file (empty file or all lines invalid). Please check the file content and upload again.

batch.description: Select a position to view its imported batches. If a batch's data quality is unsatisfactory, you can delete it (candidate links and scores are removed along with it; talents no longer linked to any position are also cleaned up).
batch.selectPlaceholder: Select a position to view batches
batch.deleted: Deleted {{links}} links, cleaned up {{talents}} orphaned talents
batch.deleteConfirmDescription: All candidate links and scores in this batch will be deleted.

compImport.heading: Competition Talent Import
compImport.description: Upload a single-contest JSONL produced by comp-talent-crawler (schema v1.0: meta → series → contest → team* → person*). Results of that contest will be fully replaced.
compImport.uploadHint: Only a single .jsonl file is supported (crawler output format, ≤ 20MB)
compImport.importDone: Import finished: {{persons}} persons and {{results}} results stored, {{skipped}} lines skipped

report.title: Import Report
report.noDataDescription: No valid records found in the file (empty file or all lines invalid). To protect existing data, nothing was deleted or written this time.

academic.description: Generates embeddings for academic talents to power semantic search and smart recommendations. Requires an LLM API configuration. Generation runs asynchronously in the background; duration depends on the number of talents.

os.title: Open-Source Talent Embeddings
os.description: Generates embeddings for open-source developers to power semantic search and smart recommendations. Current model: {{model}}. Generation runs asynchronously in the background; duration depends on the number of developers.

osDiscover.title: Auto-Discover Popular Repos
osDiscover.description: Search GitHub for popular repos meeting the star/contributor thresholds by tech direction (preview only — nothing is saved until you select and import them into the repo config). Discovering all 75 directions takes about 2-5 minutes (subject to GitHub Search API rate limits).
